hints.title: Vowel String Classification
hints.text: A string is a vowel string if its first character and last character both belong to {'a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u'}.

hints.title: Binary Indicator Array
hints.text: Create an indicator array where element i is 1 if words[i] is a vowel string, or 0 otherwise.

hints.title: Range Query via Prefix Sums
hints.text: Precompute prefix sums of the indicator array so each query [l, r] is answered in constant time as pref[r + 1] - pref[l].

hints.title: Prefix Sum Range Query Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def vowelStrings(self, words: list[str], queries: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        vowels = set('aeiou')
        n = len(words)
        pref = [0] * (n + 1)
        for i, w in enumerate(words):
            is_v = 1 if w[0] in vowels and w[-1] in vowels else 0
            pref[i + 1] = pref[i] + is_v
        return [pref[r + 1] - pref[l] for l, r in queries]
```

complexity.notes: Linear time prefix sum construction with O(1) query response.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Counting vowel strings iteratively for each query takes O(N * Q).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory stores prefix sum array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses prefix sum array to answer static range sum queries in constant time.
